task_instance: Process the skill's documented synthetic 1D FID (two resonances at 3 and 7 ppm, 1:2 amplitude ratio, SW 4000 Hz, 400 MHz, carrier 5 ppm) through the bundled scripts/process_1d.py helper with assets/processing.json to produce a phased descending-ppm spectrum.csv, peak candidates, and signed region integrals (integration regions 2.7-3.3 and 6.7-7.3 ppm) in report.json, then verify the two peak positions, the 1:2 integral ratio, and the processing report.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is produced only by running the bundled Python helper script (scripts/process_1d.py) under Python 3.12 with the nmrglue, NumPy 2+, and SciPy packages. The office-assistant runtime cannot run code, scripts, or shell commands of any kind, cannot install software, and cannot produce binary files. Even constructing the required input is blocked: the helper ingests a binary NumPy .npz (or a binary NMRPipe time-domain file), and the documented sample input must itself be generated by executing NumPy code and written as a binary .npz, which this runtime cannot create. With no code execution there is no way to apodize, zero-fill, FFT, phase, baseline-correct, integrate, or emit spectrum.csv/report.json. The helper script and its assets are present next to SKILL.md, so this is not a missing-skill-files case; the missing ability is code execution in the runtime.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: 'Execute' section runs 'uv run ... python skills/nmrglue/scripts/process_1d.py fid.npz processing.json nmr-result'; compatibility line requires Python 3.12+, nmrglue, NumPy 2+, SciPy with install needing network. Deliverables are spectrum.csv and report.json produced by that executable. The documented sample input is built with 'import numpy as np ... np.savez("fid.npz", fid=fid)'. Glob of the skill repo confirms the bundled files exist: skills/nmrglue/SKILL.md, assets/processing.json, references/acquisition-and-validation.md, scripts/process_1d.py. Read assets/processing.json (SW 4000 Hz, 400 MHz, carrier 5 ppm, fid_sign -i, zero_fill 32768, integration regions [[2.7,3.3],[6.7,7.3]]). No Bash/shell was used per task constraints; the runtime grants only text read/write/edit and web tools, none of which can execute Python or write a binary .npz, so no deliverable could be produced or verified. result.json written to the r040 work directory.
